title: The Influenza Blueprint: How Viruses Invade
description: Explore the molecular mechanisms behind seasonal influenza strains and viral cellular entry. Understand how human immune defenses respond during the first critical 48 hours of infection.

title: Decoding the Common Cold vs Influenza
description: A comprehensive clinical comparison between Rhinoviruses and Orthomyxoviridae. Learn how symptomatic onset speeds differentiate upper respiratory infections from systemic flu.

title: Fever and Immune Mobilization
description: Discover why human core temperatures rise during pathogenic attacks. Examine pyrogens, hypothalamic set point shifts, and effective fever management strategies.

title: Modern Antivirals and Hydration Protocols
description: An in depth look at neuraminidase inhibitors, cellular hydration mechanics, and symptom relief agents designed to shorten recovery timelines safely.
